forbidden_content: unverified engineering claims promoted as facts
read_policy: Search Engram by PANEL_ID/project before resuming long-running work when prior context may matter.
Reconcile retrieved memory against canonical GitHub files before using it.
If Engram conflicts with canonical project files, canonical project files win and the conflict must be logged.
write_policy: Write only concise non-sensitive summaries after significant project milestones or confirmed methodological learning.
Store pointers to canonical artifacts rather than duplicating large technical records.
A successful Engram write does not replace GitHub memory synchronization.
failure_policy: If Engram is unavailable or a write is blocked by platform security, continue with GitHub canonical memory and deterministic gates. Never weaken release control.

current_connection_check.consequence: Integration is configured, but no Engram write is claimed until a write succeeds.
